description: SpecReview: deny Write calls that would rewrite most of a spec under review (use Edit instead), surface submitted reviews that no background wait picked up, and gate ExitPlanMode on a SpecReview review of the plan. The first two hooks call the specreview CLI on PATH, finish in well under a second, print nothing on error and always exit 0. The plan gate (specreview plan-gate) blocks until the reviewer submits a review, then allows the plan or denies it with the feedback; it fails open (prints nothing, exits 0) on any error or when Claude Code cancels it.
